screens.label: Overview
screens.title: The whole portfolio on one screen
screens.text: Value, returns, history and allocation, priced from live quotes in your base currency.

hotspots.title: Total value
hotspots.text: Holdings plus cash in your base currency, with the gain since your first deposit.

hotspots.title: Today's move
hotspots.text: The day gain across every position, from live Yahoo Finance quotes.

hotspots.title: The fine print
hotspots.text: Invested capital, realized P&L, dividends, fees and taxes withheld. Pick the tiles under Metrics.

hotspots.title: Against a benchmark
hotspots.text: Draw the S&P 500, Nasdaq 100, MSCI World, Euro Stoxx 50 or FTSE All-World over your returns. Zoom from one month to all time.

hotspots.title: Performance history
hotspots.text: Value with cash, invested capital and cost basis, day by day since the first transaction.

hotspots.title: Allocation
hotspots.text: Asset classes on the inner ring, single holdings on the outer one.

screens.label: Positions
screens.title: Every position, with indicators
screens.text: Stocks, ETFs and crypto in one table, in any listing currency.

hotspots.title: Positions
hotspots.text: Ticker, asset type, shares and average cost for each holding.

hotspots.title: Any currency
hotspots.text: The price in its own currency next to the value in yours, converted at live FX rates, with the portfolio weight.

hotspots.title: Day and total return
hotspots.text: In percent and in money, for today and since you bought.

hotspots.title: 52-week range
hotspots.text: Where the price sits between the low and the high of the last year.

hotspots.title: RSI 14
hotspots.text: Momentum for each holding, marked oversold, neutral or overbought.

hotspots.title: Search and filter
hotspots.text: Find a symbol or narrow the table to stocks, ETFs or crypto.

screens.label: Analysis
screens.title: Dividends you got and dividends to come
screens.text: The Analysis tab: exposure, income and markets. Here, twelve months of expected income, yields and the next ex-dividend dates.

hotspots.title: Income at a glance
hotspots.text: Expected income for the next 12 months, what came in over the last 12, yield on cost and current yield.

hotspots.title: Monthly income
hotspots.text: Declared and estimated dividends, month by month.

hotspots.title: Next 30 days
hotspots.text: Ex-dividend dates coming up, with the amount per share.

hotspots.title: Per holding
hotspots.text: Payment frequency, the next ex-date, both yields and the income expected from each position.

hotspots.title: Three views
hotspots.text: Exposure to sectors, countries and the stocks inside your funds, income and events, and the markets. One at a time.

screens.label: Assistant
screens.title: An assistant that knows your portfolio
screens.text: Ask anything about your holdings. It runs on the model you pick: local, a cloud key or the Claude Code CLI.

hotspots.title: Daily brief
hotspots.text: Each morning the assistant sums up the last session. The brief lands here, so you can ask a follow-up.

hotspots.title: See what it sees
hotspots.text: Open the exact context the model gets: weights, percentages and tickers. Money amounts stay home.

hotspots.title: Your model
hotspots.text: Ollama, llama.cpp, LM Studio, any OpenAI-compatible key, or the Claude Code CLI.

hotspots.title: Ask anything
hotspots.text: Questions about holdings, risk or metrics, answered from your own numbers.

screens.label: Reports
screens.title: A written report every week
screens.text: The assistant reviews the week: movers, risks and what to watch. Missed one while the app was closed? It runs on the next start.

hotspots.title: Executive summary
hotspots.text: The week in one line, on top of the full review.

hotspots.title: The review
hotspots.text: Winners, laggards, macro context and risks, written from your holdings and live market data.

hotspots.title: Any week
hotspots.text: Each report covers one week. Pick an earlier week or analyze the current one again.

hotspots.title: The numbers
hotspots.text: Value, period return, cash and the top winner and loser of the week.

hotspots.title: No black box
hotspots.text: The model, the time and the full prompt behind each report.

screens.label: Suggestions
screens.title: Rebalancing ideas, with the math done
screens.text: The assistant proposes trades from weights alone. The app turns them into shares and amounts with live prices.

hotspots.title: A concrete trade
hotspots.text: Action, shares, amount and the weight before and after, with the reason and a price range.

hotspots.title: Weights only
hotspots.text: The model never sees money amounts. The app computes them on your machine.

hotspots.title: Target portfolio
hotspots.text: Every holding now and after the selected suggestions, with the change in percentage points.

hotspots.title: Fresh ideas
hotspots.text: Run it again after you trade. The list says when transactions changed since the last run.

screens.label: Transactions
screens.title: Every trade, dividend and deposit
screens.text: Type them in or import a broker CSV. The ledger is the single source of every number.

hotspots.title: Broker CSV import
hotspots.text: Trade Republic, Scalable Capital, Interactive Brokers and Degiro, with a dry-run preview.

hotspots.title: Add by hand
hotspots.text: Buys, sells, dividends, interest, deposits and withdrawals, with fees and taxes.

hotspots.title: Search the ledger
hotspots.text: Filter by symbol or by transaction type.

hotspots.title: Clear types
hotspots.text: Each entry carries its type, so dividends and sells stand out at a glance.

hotspots.title: Fees and taxes
hotspots.text: Kept per transaction and summed on the overview.
